intent: Replace procedural Foshan city geometry with a real-world OGC 3D Tiles pipeline capable of Google Earth-class photorealistic rendering.
requirements: MUST render real photogrammetric or equivalent textured 3D mesh for final visual acceptance
MUST NOT use procedural OSM building extrusion as a photorealistic fallback
MUST support Google Photorealistic 3D Tiles and a generic custom 3D Tiles source
MUST keep runtime credentials out of repository files
MUST display dynamic provider attribution and Google Maps brand attribution when Google content is used
MUST stream LOD tiles and expose a high-quality 8 px screen-space error preset
acceptance: Manual: connect a licensed source with Foshan photogrammetric coverage and inspect Zumiao, Qiandeng Lake, Century Lotus, Xiqiao Mountain and Qinghui Garden in ultra mode
Manual: verify roof, facade, terrain and vegetation details originate from the real textured mesh rather than generated geometry
